title: Airflow SLA Miss Rate by DAG
dataSources: Airflow logs (`airflow:scheduler`, `airflow:worker`, `airflow:task`), REST API `/dags/*/dagRuns`, StatsD counters (`airflow:statsd`), and metadata tables via DB Connect.
app: Airflow task/scheduler logs via Universal Forwarder; Airflow REST API (`/api/v1`) and StatsD/OpenTelemetry metrics via HEC scripted inputs; Airflow metadata database (`dag_run`, `task_instance`, `job`) via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=airflow:scheduler "SLA miss"
| rex "dag_id=(?<dag_id>\S+)"
| timechart span=1d count as sla_misses by dag_id
| addtotals
description: Aggregates Airflow SLA-miss callbacks per DAG over time so teams can see which pipelines chronically breach their agreed completion windows.
value: One-off SLA misses are noise; a rising trend for a specific DAG signals capacity or upstream-dependency problems worth an engineering investment.
implementation: Ensure DAGs define `sla` on tasks; ingest scheduler SLA-miss logs; schedule daily and review the worst DAGs weekly.
visualization: Timechart of SLA misses per DAG, ranked table.
grandmaExplanation: We track which regularly-scheduled data jobs keep finishing late so the worst offenders can be fixed first.
